snippet.title: Gothic 1 Remake | Thank You Message
snippet.description:
Two months after launch, we want to say one thing: Thank you.

Thank you for your feedback, your videos, your livestreams, and for exploring every corner of the Colony. We're listening, we're watching, and we're committed to supporting Gothic 1 Remake with future updates, improvements, and new features.

Welcome back to the Colony. May Innos be with you.
